metadata.disclaimer: IMPORTANT LIMITATIONS: (1) This reference file is based on sampling-based audit (63 of 358 references exhaustively verified). While statistically significant, not all references were individually verified. (2) Source accessibility: 15% of primary sources (Bursa Malaysia, Pavilion REIT website) had access restrictions during audit; some facts rely on data aggregator information. (3) Market data (share prices, yields, market caps) are time-sensitive and were accurate as of 2026-04-25; values change daily. (4) Some references rely on secondary sources (analyst reports, industry benchmarks) rather than primary filings. (5) Appropriate rounding used for percentages and calculations. Users should verify critical facts against original sources before making investment decisions.
metadata.timeSensitiveNote: References flagged with 'timeSensitive: true' contain market data that changes daily (share prices, yields, market caps, trading volumes, NAV-based yields). These values were accurate at time of creation but should be verified current via KLSE Screener or Bursa Malaysia before use.
